scope.source_assignment_rule: After declared region points are spread, TetGen starts uninfected components at max declared region attribute + 1 and increments once per uninfected connected component. These are automatic region labels, not independently declared material IDs.

interpretation: For this exact closed Fat input, attributes 17-22 identify six automatic connected region components wholly inside the one declared material domain (attribute 16). The verified interpretation is 17-22 -> material 16 for this input only.
not_proven: No general mapping rule for other PLCs or material sets.

No valid Float32 cell orientation for the volume: the seeded rerun still has 16 zero and 89 negative cells.
No preservation of the 105 input boundary segments in the seeded rerun; it adds 210 output boundary faces.
